speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You have been on the floor since I boiled the ink. The jug is in my other hand. Is this the king who was dying, or a new trouble.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The dying was the second act, Mistress. This is the third. He has come ashore.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Ashore where, sir.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wales, if the book is to be believed. He stoops. He puts his hand to the earth.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. A man who greets the ground is either grateful or finished. Which is he.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He does not know yet. I have not written the speech that would tell him.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Then the ground is a greeting, and not a grave. I can allow a greeting.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I hope the ground is not the point. A play that ends in a stoop has not told me who takes the crown.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody takes it today. I wrote a little more this morning, and I am done until the speech.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then you are eating, sir. Three pence, same as Sunday, if you sit.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is still a penny, and still a finger and a half short. I have not recut the notch to flatter it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not asking you to. I will not put the loaf into the play to make the king wiser.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Good. A loaf is a loaf. My name is still my name. I am not a lesson in your third act.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: As I am a Christian woman, sit. You may stoop in the play. At my table you sit, and you pay.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three pence. I am sitting. The speech is three words on the tables, and it is not this dinner.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will not ask for the words, sir, if they are not for the house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They are not for the house. They have not become a speech.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then keep them. I have a plot enough. He is ashore. He greets the ground. The ground is not the point until you show me whose it is.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will take that ruling. It is smaller than a kingdom, and it fits the table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Smaller is what I wanted. I am not asking who puts him down. I have not written that.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I was not offering it. Eat. The page can wait until you have chewed.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will clear when you are done, sir. The floor has had enough of the walking.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The morning is done. He is ashore on the leaf. I am at the table.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Then both of you are where you should be. I am for the loom when the bread is gone.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Go when you like. He has sat, which is the threepence begun. The coin can follow the jug.
